meta.purpose: Validate released v10.0.6 surfaces across Pi and Claude live runtimes, exercise the bootstrap failure table against a clean tag worktree, verify release tag CI status, and audit intervening commits to settle historical release disposition.
meta.problem: v10.0.6 was released as the required successor to intent-to-completion, but formal G6 live proof, tag-level bootstrap recovery validation, and historical disposition remained unfinalized.
meta.solution: Execute isolated, reproducible validation tests on host ai and in an isolated git worktree, producing verifiable text and markdown evidence artifacts without modifying repository code.

tasks.description: Initialize isolated git worktree at .worktrees/v10-validation-tag checked out to tag v10.0.6
Capture G6 live execution proof for Pi harness against installed v10.0.6 on host ai
Capture G6 live execution proof for Claude harness against installed v10.0.6 plugin on host ai
Execute bootstrap failure table and driver recovery test suite in tag v10.0.6 worktree and record failure-mode receipts
Verify green CI workflow run status for git tag v10.0.6 commit and record CI verification receipt
Audit post-tag commits between v10.0.6 and successor releases and synthesize historical release disposition report
Cleanly remove worktree .worktrees/v10-validation-tag and compile final validation summary
verify_commands: test -s docs/masterplan/v10-validation/validation-summary.md && ! git worktree list | grep -q v10-validation-tag
